visualCharacteristics: A section head (light kicker over a bold title) above a horizontally scrolling row of picture cards with title, text and an arrow link, with prev/next chevron buttons and an optional closing CTA button.
contentPattern: Leading rows without an image hold the kicker and title headings (a link paragraph there becomes a head CTA); each card row has a picture in cell 1 and an h3 title, text paragraph and link paragraph in cell 2; rows after the last card hold the CTA paragraph (em link = outline button).
usage: Use to present a set of linked feature or USP cards with images under a section heading, scrolling as a carousel when they do not fit.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any picture-card row with a section head; pick a variant class (square, light, tiles, trio, four, usp, channels) for the card layout rather than creating a new block.
